notes.title: Patch Notes 17
Patch Notes 16
notes.content:
Patch includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Index controllers can now animate the hand models in a basic way (no finger tracking, sorry).
[*] Changed 'finger-tip' activation to enable when trigger unclicked and disabled when trigged is clicked.  This should make interacting with buttons more definitive.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 15
notes.content:
This patch includes the following:

[list]
[*] Added a brightness and contrast slider to the in-game options menu. *
[*] Fixed issue where hands might not reappear after leaving Steam dashboard - which also fixed a potential issue with WMR controllers.
[*] Command denied - adjusted trigger collider in the airshaft so it would only recognise the player.
[*] Command denied - tweaked breakers in airshaft that got reset on a checkpoint reload to avoid confusion.
[*] Tweaked corridor joins to reduce the lips that may have interfered with player movement.
[*] Anomaly - scan room, collider adjustments to prevent player potentially clipping through and avoiding having to complete the puzzle.
[*] Other minor fixes.


* This change has affected the save settings file structure. In the event that the option doesn't show, you may have to delete the file so it can be recreated. Located here:

C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\LocalLow\WhippedUP_gaming\Prisoner 518\game_settings.set


[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 14
notes.content:
Patch Notes Include:

[list]
[*] Save slot naming corrected for final level, instead of the slot being labelled as 'empty'.
[*] Fixed a language bug on the message system in the admissions room on the prison level.
[*] Added a delay to the pause menu to help prevent hand models not enabling again after leaving the menu system.
[*] Extended the basement ladder in the prison block. 
[*] Default run speed has been increased.
[/list]

Also note, there is a pinned thread in the forum explaining the use of BETA builds, if there is one available.

notes.title: Patch Update 10
notes.content:
Patch notes include:

[list]
[*] Security level: adjusted lighting on the staff elevator manual door control so that it was clearer to see what to do in the area.
[*] Security level: adjusted some geometry colliders that would sometimes prevent the player from accessing the area to collect the blue keycard.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 9
notes.content:
Patch notes include:

[list]
[*] PDA object highlighter on the Offices level would sometimes interfere with the power button preventing the player from turning the PDA on and reading the message - is fixed.
[*] Ladder fall in lift would sometimes spawn player too low in the death-room preventing the player from interacting with the orbs in the room - is fixed.
[*] Added blackness geometry to vent escape on Offices level where player could clip head through ceiling and view the entire level.
[*] Adjusted lighting in the comms HQ so the player could see the PDA more clearly.
[*] Lebowski's PC in the director's room has been moved closer to the desk edge to allow for easier usage.
[*] Fixed hangar desctruction sequence where the player could circumvent a trigger preventing sequence from playing out.
[*] Fixed hangar desctruction sequence where exit door wouldn't open sometimes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 8
Patch Update 7

notes.title: Patch Update 4
notes.content:
Changelog of v005 includes:

[list]
[*] Added text to the save slots on the main menu indicating if the slot is in use and the current level, default of 'empty' is an unused slot
[*] Further fix on the shuttle where the player could trigger logic when it shouldn't, allowing the journey to start with the hatch door open
[*] General collider tidy across all levels
[*] Fixed additional geometry issues in the maintenance tunnels
[*] Adjusted ladder height in maintenance tunnels
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 3
notes.content:
Patch notes for v004 include:

[list]
[*] Fixed geometry collider in Admissions' vent that would allow the player to drop through the game world.
[*] Fixed the basement grabbable handlebar always being active before the basement cover was removed.
[*] Added decals to the basement grabbable handlebar.
[*] Moved the PLC PC closer to the edge of the counter for easier operation.
[*] Added a window to the restaurant's exit door to aid in puzzle completion.
[*] Adjusted restaurant exit doors colliders to prevent players in some cases being able to clip through them.
[*] Added a wall light at the restaurant's exit to aid in visibility during puzzle solving.
[*] Improved the desk collider at the rec's reception area allowing players to circumvent the puzzle.
[*] Corrected draw-distance issues in the office area.
[*] Adjusted the death collision system when falling in the large vent area, removing the potential for the player to not trigger their death and thus remaining trapped.
[*] Shuttle hatch closed icon set to on by default.
[*] Hatch logic adjusted to prevent players from starting the shuttle journey whilst the door is open.
[*] Added a collider inside the shuttle preventing the player from entering the cockpit when it should only be possible via the enter grab handles.
[*] Fixed the journey exit tunnel not opening when it should.
[*] The rear cab of the shuttle now turns off the hatch closed icon when the hatch is opened from the outside.
[*] Fixed the occlusion bake for the hangar level.
[*] Fixed some missing geometry in the maintenance tunnels.
[*] Fixed an issue where the boss fight would trigger again if players had left the room and re-entered and had already killed the boss.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Update 2
notes.content:
Patch changelog includes:

[list]
[*] Added contextual text during loading screens to give a feel of story progression - chapter heading if you will.
[*] Changed collider meshes in sub security console area that may have conflicted with the player-collider causing unusual teleporting.
[*] Fixed a potential issue where the red-keycard might detach itself from the holster after leaving the main scanning tube.
[/list]
